resources.string: Open Flow uses Accessibility only to detect focused text fields and insert your on-device speech-to-text. It does not replace your keyboard. No cloud. No analytics. Password and phone fields are skipped.
Enable Open Flow in Accessibility so the floating mic bubble can type into any app. Keep your normal keyboard.
Microphone is required to dictate and record.
No recordings yet. Tap Record or add a demo session.
No INTERNET permission. Voice stays on device by default.
How it works: keep Gboard (or any keyboard). Open Flow shows a floating bubble. Tap bubble → talk → text inserts in the focused field.
